# vktShaderClockTests.cpp

## Overview

[`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L1) is the GLSL
shader-executor test file for `VK_KHR_shader_clock`. The file comment states that the cases ensure values are read from
the `OpReadClockKHR` opcode, and the implementation generates shaders that read each clock twice and fail only when the
second observed value is lower than the first observed value
([`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L21-L24),
[`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L170-L212)).

## Role

Combined registration and implementation file. The GLSL category root registers this file through
[`createShaderClockTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/vktTestPackage.cpp#L1274-L1279), the file returns a
`shader_clock` group from [`createShaderClockTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L255-L258),
and [`addShaderClockTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L223-L250) builds the
stage and operation matrix.

## Registration Hierarchy

```text
glsl.shader_clock
├── vertex
├── fragment
└── compute
```

## Test Families

### vertex — Vertex-stage shader-clock cases

The `vertex` group is one of the three stage groups generated from the `stages[]` array in
[`addShaderClockTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L223-L242). For this stage,
the inner registration loop adds one [`ShaderClockCase`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L130-L167)
for each entry of `operations[]`: `clockARB`, `clock2x32ARB`, `clockRealtimeEXT`, and `clockRealtime2x32EXT`
([`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L227-L247)). The shared
executor code routes vertex tests to `VertexShaderExecutor` for source generation and execution
([`vktShaderExecutor.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderExecutor.cpp#L4200-L4204),
[`vktShaderExecutor.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderExecutor.cpp#L4236-L4240)).

### fragment — Fragment-stage shader-clock cases

The `fragment` group is generated by the same stage loop and receives the same four operation names from
`operations[]` ([`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L225-L247)).
The shared executor dispatch maps fragment source generation and execution to `FragmentShaderExecutor`
([`vktShaderExecutor.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderExecutor.cpp#L4214-L4216),
[`vktShaderExecutor.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderExecutor.cpp#L4246-L4248)).

### compute — Compute-stage shader-clock cases

The `compute` group is the final direct child generated by the stage loop and also receives `clockARB`,
`clock2x32ARB`, `clockRealtimeEXT`, and `clockRealtime2x32EXT`
([`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L225-L247)). The shared
executor dispatch maps compute source generation and execution to `ComputeShaderExecutor`
([`vktShaderExecutor.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderExecutor.cpp#L4217-L4219),
[`vktShaderExecutor.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderExecutor.cpp#L4248-L4249)).

The four operation names are not separate direct children of `glsl.shader_clock`; they are the direct test cases under
each stage group. `clockARB` and `clock2x32ARB` use the subgroup-clock path (`SUBGROUP`), while `clockRealtimeEXT` and
`clockRealtime2x32EXT` use the device-clock path (`DEVICE`) as encoded in `operations[]`
([`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L68-L85),
[`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L227-L230)).

## Parameter Dimensions

| Dimension | Observed values / evidence |
|---|---|
| Element count | `NUM_ELEMENTS = 32`; each `iterate()` call allocates 32 host outputs and executes 32 shader invocations through the executor at [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L63-L66) and [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L103-L113). |
| Shader stage | `glu::SHADERTYPE_VERTEX`, `glu::SHADERTYPE_FRAGMENT`, and `glu::SHADERTYPE_COMPUTE` are the only entries in `stages[]`, and their registered group names are derived as `vertex`, `fragment`, and `compute` at [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L225-L242). |
| Clock scope | `SUBGROUP` and `DEVICE` are the two `clockType` values, with `realTimeTest` set when the operation uses `DEVICE` at [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L68-L72) and [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L159-L166). |
| Result width | `BIT_32` and `BIT_64` are the two `bitType` values; 64-bit operations generate `uint64_t` reads, while 32-bit operations generate `uvec2` reads at [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L74-L78) and [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L175-L194). |
| Operation names | `clockARB`, `clock2x32ARB`, `clockRealtimeEXT`, and `clockRealtime2x32EXT` are the exact `testName` values used both as test-case names and as generated GLSL function calls at [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L80-L85), [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L179-L180), [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L188-L189), and [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L227-L230). |
| Output symbol | Each shader spec declares one high-precision unsigned-vector output named `out0`; host-side output storage is a `std::vector<uint64_t>` whose addresses are passed to the executor at [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L105-L113) and [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L211-L212). |

## Support / Feature Requirements

| Requirement | Evidence |
|---|---|
| `VK_KHR_shader_clock` | Every `ShaderClockCase` calls `context.requireDeviceFunctionality("VK_KHR_shader_clock")` before checking operation-specific features at [`ShaderClockCase::checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L152-L155). |
| 64-bit integer support | Only `BIT_64` operations call `context.requireDeviceCoreFeature(DEVICE_CORE_FEATURE_SHADER_INT64)` at [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L156-L158); the 64-bit shader path also requires `GL_ARB_gpu_shader_int64` in generated GLSL at [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L175-L185). |
| Device-clock feature | `DEVICE` operations set `realTimeTest` and throw `NotSupportedError` unless `shaderClockFeatures.shaderDeviceClock` is true at [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L159-L164). Device-clock shaders require `GL_EXT_shader_realtime_clock` at [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L196-L199). |
| Subgroup-clock feature | Non-`DEVICE` operations require `shaderClockFeatures.shaderSubgroupClock` at [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L159-L166). Subgroup-clock shaders enable `GL_ARB_shader_clock` at [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L200-L203). |
| Stage feature gates | This file registers only vertex, fragment, and compute stages, and `ShaderClockCase::checkSupport()` does not call the shared `checkSupportShader()` helper; no additional tessellation, geometry, mesh, or task feature gate is visible for this file's cases in the inspected source ([`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L142-L167), [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L225-L247)). |

## Verification Methods

- Each test instance initializes 32 `uint64_t` host output slots to `0xcdcdcdcd`, passes their addresses to
  `m_executor->execute()`, and then validates the resulting vector
  ([`ShaderClockTestInstance::iterate()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L103-L118)).
- Generated 64-bit shader code reads the selected clock function twice into `uint64_t time1` and `uint64_t time2`,
  initializes `out0` to zero, and writes `out0.x = 1` only when `time1 > time2`
  ([`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L175-L185)).
- Generated 2x32-bit shader code reads the selected clock function twice into `uvec2` values and compares them
  lexicographically with `time.y` as the high word and `time.x` as the low word; it writes `out0.x = 1` when the first
  timestamp is greater than the second timestamp
  ([`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L186-L194)).
- Host validation is a non-decreasing-clock smoke check: `validateOutput()` passes only when every output entry is zero,
  so any invocation that wrote the failure sentinel `1` causes `Result comparison failed`
  ([`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L114-L124)).
- The inspected code does not compare against an expected timestamp value and does not require the clock value to be
  non-zero; it only rejects a backwards pair observed by the generated shader code
  ([`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L175-L194),
  [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L121-L124)).

## Test Principles

- The file uses a compact generated matrix: three shader stages multiplied by four clock operations, produced by nested
  loops in [`addShaderClockTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L223-L250).
- Test-case names are also the generated GLSL clock built-in calls, keeping registration and shader source generation tied
  to the same `testType::testName` field
  ([`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L80-L85),
  [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L179-L189),
  [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L227-L230)).
- Support checks are operation-specific rather than stage-specific in this file: the clock extension is always required,
  64-bit integer support is conditional on `BIT_64`, and clock-scope support is conditional on `DEVICE` versus
  `SUBGROUP` ([`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L152-L167)).
- Verification is intentionally limited to detecting a local backwards timestamp pair within one shader invocation; equal
  consecutive values are accepted because the shader writes a failure value only for strict `time1 > time2` comparisons
  ([`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L181-L184),
  [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L190-L193)).

## Notes / Uncertainties

- No separate helper file registers additional `shader_clock` children in the inspected source; the registered hierarchy is
  built in [`addShaderClockTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L223-L250).
- The source comment names `OpReadClockKHR`, but this file generates GLSL built-in calls and delegates compilation/source
  handling to the shared shader-executor infrastructure rather than embedding SPIR-V text directly
  ([`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L21-L24),
  [`vktShaderClockTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderClockTests.cpp#L147-L150),
  [`vktShaderExecutor.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktShaderExecutor.cpp#L4198-L4231)).
